settings_companions_purpose: Download and manage the helper programs Lodestar can run beside itself: qBittorrent, Prowlarr and FlareSolverr.
settings_companions_intro: Companions are separate programs that Lodestar can download, start and stop for you. Nothing is downloaded until you confirm it.
settings_companions_off: Companions are switched off in this copy of Lodestar.
settings_companions_load_failed: The list of companions couldn't be loaded.
settings_companions_stale: The list couldn't be refreshed. What's shown is the last the server said.
settings_companions_restarting: Restarting. Its health shows here when it's back.
settings_companions_offer_intro: Lodestar will download this program and check it against the checksum below. Nothing is downloaded until you press the button.
settings_companions_offer_runs_value: On this computer, started and stopped by Lodestar.
settings_companions_remove_intro: Removing {name} stops it and deletes only what is listed here.
settings_companions_cred_once: Shown once. Copy it now: after you hide it, you must enter your password again to see it.
settings_companions_cred_password_help: Asked every time and never remembered.
settings_companions_regen_body: The old one stops working at once. Anything still using it will need the new one.
settings_companions_regen_done: A new one is being made. Show it again once the companion has restarted.
settings_companions_paste_help: Paste the temporary password the companion printed in its log. It is stored sealed and never shown again.
settings_companions_template_help: For running it as a separate container instead of letting Lodestar start it. Nothing here is stored.
settings_companions_route_note: A companion's route is copied from the source that needs it when the companion first starts. A later change to that source's route doesn't reach it: it keeps the route it started with.
settings_companions_socks_title: If this companion's route uses a SOCKS5 proxy
settings_companions_socks_email: If this companion's route uses a SOCKS5 proxy, email notifications connect directly and do not use it. Leave them off.
settings_companions_socks_flaresolverr: If this companion's route uses a SOCKS5 proxy, a FlareSolverr pairing leaves directly, not through it. Don't pair them.
settings_companions_socks_indexer_proxie: If this companion's route uses a SOCKS5 proxy, per-indexer proxies you add in Prowlarr bypass the route.
settings_companions_add_help: Detect looks for companions on this computer's usual addresses. Or enter the address of one you run yourself.
settings_companions_add_url_help: For example http://192.168.1.20:8080. Lodestar checks that the right program answers there.
settings_companions_code_native_in_conta: Lodestar is running in a container, so it can't install this program itself. Run it as its own container instead.
settings_companions_code_unsupported_pla: This program isn't available for this computer.
settings_companions_code_awaiting_pin: This companion isn't available to install yet.
settings_companions_code_guided_only: This one is set up through the guided setup, not downloaded by Lodestar.
settings_companions_code_confirmation_mi: What you confirmed no longer matches what's on offer. Nothing was changed. Open it again to see the current details.
settings_companions_code_not_wired: Companions can't be started in this copy of Lodestar.
settings_companions_code_busy: Something else is changing this companion. Try again in a minute.
settings_companions_code_unavailable: Companions are switched off in this copy of Lodestar.
settings_companions_code_rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
settings_companions_code_no_credential: There is nothing saved to show.
settings_companions_code_installed: Lodestar installed this one itself, so this isn't needed.
settings_companions_code_generated_pendi: A new password may already be in use. Show it first, or confirm again.
settings_companions_code_bad_template_in: One of the values can't be used in a template.
settings_companions_code_unauthorized: The companion refused the saved password.
settings_companions_code_protocol: The companion answered in a way Lodestar doesn't understand.
settings_companions_code_network: Lodestar couldn't reach its server. Check the connection and try again.
settings_companions_code_other: That didn't work. Try again in a minute.
settings_companions_template_route_exist: Through a gluetun container I already run
settings_companions_template_direct_warn: Directly means its traffic leaves outside any VPN. Choose gluetun to keep it inside one.
settings_companions_template_folder_help: Optional. Leave empty for the default.
settings_companions_code_managed_client_: Lodestar is using a download client you set up yourself. Remove it in Integrations first, then try again.
settings_companions_code_sink_refused: The download client refused that. Check its settings and try again.
settings_companions_code_timed_out: That took too long. Try again in a minute.
